title: tariff._smooth_topk_sum's k<=0 guard arm survives the full gate: no check pins k=0, and no caller can reach it
claim: Changing tariff.py:744 `if x.size == 0 or k <= 0:` to `k < 0` makes _smooth_topk_sum bill the soft top-1 (20.0 kW) instead of 0.0 for k=0, and the full GATE_SCOPE=full GOLDEN_MODE=drift gate stays green.
mechanism: Both production callers (tariff._peak_charge at tariff.py:982 and peak_cost_batch at :1204) clamp k onto 1..n before the top-k, so the k<=0 arm of the line-744 guard is unreachable through production inputs. tests/features.py pins the in-function clamp's arms (#932: k=8, k=2.5, k=0.5) but never k=0, the one value the guard and the clamp disagree on (guard: 0.0; clamp's stated contract 'a count under one bills the single largest window': top-1).

evidence.command: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m31_topk_zero.py ; PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/fullgate.py run --src c2 --key d931ab195b940b0c
evidence.unit: kW (topk_k0_mutant; baseline 0.0; full gate under the mutant: rc 0, 0 failing scripts)
evidence.machine: box D3-top6: 4 vCPU Intel Xeon @ 2.30GHz, 16 GB, Linux, venv-ci CPython 3.14
evidence.contention_note: T3 prescreen complete workers (3) running during the harness; the counts are contention-immune. The full gate ran alone (wall 3404.7 s, provisional).

perturbation.change: tariff.py:744 `k <= 0` -> `k < 0` (R10 C2 M31), in memory in the harness and committed on a gate commit in fullgate.py

metric_definition: soft top-k sum _smooth_topk_sum returns for k=0 on the bill [10,10,10,20,20] kW; plus calls reaching it with k<=0 via peak_cost_smooth/peak_cost_batch at peaks_averaged -2..7
phenomenon_property: Every arm of a production guard is either reachable from a production input and pinned by a gate check, or removed; a guard arm that disagrees with the function's own pinned contract is not left unpinned.

null_control.note: k=1 and k=3 on the same bill: mutant and baseline identical, so the edit only moves the k<=0 arm; 111 smooth-arm calls through the public entries, peaks_averaged -2..7, none with k<=0. Full-gate null (comment-only marker commit) rc 0, 3446.2 s.

reproduction_steps: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/fullgate.py null && PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/fullgate.py run --src c2 --key d931ab195b940b0c
proposed_fix_scope: Decide k=0's contract once: either drop the `k <= 0` arm (the clamp then bills top-1, matching the #932 'count under one' pin) or keep it and pin `_smooth_topk_sum(x, 0, tau) == 0.0` beside the #932 checks in tests/features.py (the check that should have failed: features.py's #932 clamp block, tests/features.py:4241-4270). The batch twin _smooth_topk_sum_batch (tariff.py:800) shares the question.
